obligations.description: i_nRst is synchronous active-low; only source rising edges clear active state, beat count, busy flag, bank/index, write stencil, etc. Colors, addresses, read caches, and masks that are not reset must be established by legal transactions before use. fifoFull/fifoComplete are undriven and constantly Z in functional simulation; they do not indicate the existence of a command FIFO.
obligations.setup: With all requests low, ack low, and saveBGBlock=0, first cross 2 effective reset edges.
obligations.stimulus: Change the active-low reset between edges to confirm that it does not clear state immediately, then cross an edge; operate after legal cache/color writes respectively, and observe Z on the undriven FIFO outputs.
obligations.expected: Synchronous control reset; do not assume unreset storage is cleared to 0, and do not check its data values before legal establishment.
obligations.sampling: Bus outputs are combinational functions of the current state/inputs and may be sampled before the edge after inputs have been stable for 1ns; sequential state updates on the gpuClk edge.
obligations.checker: Predict using independent protocol state and input history; perform four-state actual/expected comparisons in legally valid windows; report errors for X/Z valid data, and require the two undriven FIFO outputs to be Z.

obligations.description: The TEX address prioritizes L, while the completion side latches the R request bit at initiation: when both requests are high, the address may be L while completion is for R.
